build_dataset_cars196: build a TensorFlow dataset builder for the Cars196 car classification dataset with 196 classes
create_dataset_info: create dataset info for Cars196 with image, label, bbox features and supervised keys
generate_train_examples: generate training examples from Cars196 dataset with images, labels, and bounding boxes
generate_test_examples: generate test examples from Cars196 dataset with images, labels, and bounding boxes
compute_bounding_boxes: compute normalized bounding boxes from MATLAB annotation files for Cars196 images
